segments.name: Good Times Burgers and Frozen Custard restaurants
segments.description: A quick-service drive-thru restaurant concept operating company-owned and franchised Good Times restaurants, mostly in Colorado.
segments.evidence: Good Times operates in the quick-service restaurant segment as a drive-thru concept focused on all-natural burgers, fries, and frozen custard.

segments.name: Bad Daddy's Burger Bar restaurants
segments.description: A full-service casual dining 'better burger' concept with a full bar, operating company-owned and licensed restaurants across seven states.
segments.evidence: Bad Daddy's operates in the full-service dining segment as a specialty burger bar concept

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for restaurant food and beverage sales at company-owned restaurants, and the company earns licensing and franchise revenue from licensees and franchisees.
revenueModel.evidence: We license the Bad Daddy's brand to a third-party licensee who owns and operates the Bad Daddy's restaurant located in the Charlotte Douglas International Airport.
